description: MainActivity class for an Android app, managing UI setup, navigation, banner fetching, and multiple content rails with network requests and JSON parsing.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing the main screen with banners, navigation, and content rails.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up navigation, and triggers data fetches for banners and content rails.

methods.name: setupPosterRail
methods.description: Configures a RecyclerView for horizontal poster display with spacing and item click handling.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Starts ContentInfoActivity with selected poster item details, applying a fade transition.

methods.name: fetchAllRails
methods.description: Initiates network requests to fetch data for all content rails.

methods.name: setActiveNavHome
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar to highlight the Home tab.

methods.name: setNavColors
methods.description: Updates navigation item colors and typefaces based on active selection.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Shows or hides the banner loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Shows or hides the error container.

methods.name: setBanners
methods.description: Updates banner carousel with new image URLs.

methods.name: parseBanners
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract banner image URLs.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Performs network request to fetch banner data, handles success and failure.

methods.name: fetchRail
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific content rail, updates UI on success or hides on failure.

methods.name: attemptFetchRail
methods.description: Attempts to fetch data from multiple fallback URLs sequentially until success or exhaustion.

methods.name: parsePosters
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract list of poster items with id, name, poster URL.
